blocks.text: Is phylum mein kai qisam ke groups aate hain, jaise insects (keere makore), crustaceans, spiders (makriyan), scorpions (bichhoo) aur centipedes. Yeh har qisam ki jagah (habitat) mein milte hain. Zameen par rehne wale bohat se arthropods ur bhi sakte hain.
Arthropods tamam invertebrates mein sab se kamyab (successful) hain. Taqreeban 900,000 species, yani Zameen ki naam di gayi tamam species ka do-tihai (two thirds) hissa, arthropods hain.

Arthropods triploblastic, bilaterally symmetrical, protostome coelomates hain. In ka coelom chhota (reduced) hota hai aur sirf reproductive aur excretory systems ke gird hota hai. In ke jointed appendages (joron wale aaza) hote hain jo khaas kaamon ke liye badle hue hain, jaise daurna, rengna, tairna, shikaar pakarna, saans lena, reproduction wagaira. Mukhtalif arthropods mein mouth ke gird ke jointed appendages alag alag tarah badal kar mouth parts bante hain. Jism segmented hai. Kuch segments jur kar khaas hisse banate hain jinhein tagmata kehte hain: head, thorax aur abdomen. In ka exoskeleton ya cuticle body wall ki epidermis banati hai; yeh zyada tar chitin ka hota hai. Chhote (young) arthropods mein exoskeleton waqtan fawaqtan utarta hai. Utarne ke baad janwar tezi se barhta hai aur phir naya exoskeleton banata hai. Is amal ko ecdysis ya molting kehte hain.

In ka circulatory system open type hai. Zyada tar waqt khoon hemocoel mein behta hai, jo embryo ki ek cavity, blastocoel, se banta hai. Khoon berang hota hai kyunke is mein haemoglobin nahi hota; ise haemolymph kehte hain. Zyada tar arthropods ka respiratory system hawa ki naliyon se bana hai jinhein trachea kehte hain. Bari tracheal naliyan spiracles naam ke soorakhon se bahar khulti hain. Paani mein rehne wale arthropods gills se saans lete hain. Digestive system tube jaisa hai aur alimentary canal mukhtalif hisson mein bati hai. Excretory system Malpighian tubules par mushtamil hai: yeh patli naliyan hain jo alimentary canal se nikalti hain aur midgut aur hindgut ke jor par lagi hoti hain. Nitrogen wala fuzla (nitrogenous waste) uric acid ke thos crystals ki shakal mein nikalta hai. Central nervous system achhi tarah bana hai: head mein cerebral ganglia ke teen jure hue jore dimagh (brain) banate hain. Ek dohri ventral nerve cord hai jis mein har segment mein ventral ganglia hain, aur in ganglia se chhoti nerves nikalti hain. In mein achhi tarah bani compound eyes aur antennae hote hain. Yeh apni jagah (habitat) ke hisaab se tairte, rengte ya urte hain.

blocks.alt: Upar ki qataar: Class Crustacea (crayfish, crab) aur Class Insecta (wasp, grasshopper). Beech mein tiddey (grasshopper) ki andar ki banawat pehlu se, aur chhota khaana jo head, thorax aur abdomen dikhata hai: compound eye, antenna, mouthparts, cerebral ganglia, wings, anus tak digestive tube, Malpighian tubules, tracheal tubes, hearts wali blood vessel aur ventral ganglia wali nerve cord. Neeche ki qataar: Class Arachnida (spider, mite) aur Class Myriapoda (centipede, millipede).

blocks.text: Arthropod ka nervous system neeche (ventral) hai: sar mein cerebral ganglia dimagh banate hain aur neeche ki nerve cord par har segment mein ventral ganglia hain. Dil (hearts) aur blood vessel upar peeth ki taraf hain; khoon zyada tar haemocoel mein khula behta hai (open system). Saans ke liye tracheal tubes hawa seedha cells tak le jati hain, aur Malpighian tubules fuzla nikalte hain.

Aham arthropods: insects (jaise machhar, titli, moth, bhir yani wasp, beetles, tidda yani grasshopper), kekre (crabs), lobsters, jheenga (prawn, shrimps), crayfish, makri (spider), tick, mite, bichhoo, centipedes aur millipedes.
